Keep two producers and all save/cache/session/drain behavior.

Keep legacy public MCP wrappers/signatures: Some(path) uses default500ms, None disables. Add only configured entrypoints; private helper forwards Some unchanged and warns/serves on watcher failures. Background thread owns the option. Preserve frozen run_mcp_server, DeltaTaskGuard, apply_deltas_loop byte-identically.

Unix child-only HOME config isolates tests. Existing stdio/HTTP enabled tests use true/137ms and preserve phase/recovery/session/stdout/cleanup behavior. New disabled real children initialize normally and after valid A-to-C replace repeatedly query both tool and resource for >=1500ms; both stay full phase A. Keep --headless --no-cache --save; no cache lifecycle, exact debounce, notification-absence or REPL PTY claim.
